Fourteen comments

B Phrygian

(Not G Major. B Phrygian)
Inspired by a video of an Andalucian kind of whistle playing in Phrygian I decided I wanted to play something in that mode. This weird thing is what I came up with.

↳ Posted by PJ Mediterranean on September 21st, 2007.

Hear me trying to play it. (Bb whistle and tuned down fiddle):
http://www.box.net/shared/ij5s1r7kte

The Phrygian Whistle, X:4

For those that like to listen the audio output of the music score I did this setting with no rolls.

This setting is exactly the same as setting X1 but all the offbeat rolls have been replaced by three crotchets on the same note. For the rolls on the beat I left the dotted crotchets.

For the audio in setting X1 the software of thesession is playing all rolls as dotted crotchets and in the case of offbeat rolls that is not really acceptable.

↳ Posted by Fernando Durbán Galnares on May 4th, 2021.
